## ✨ Highlights

- **Bug fixes** — disabled single-file skills can be re-enabled again (#171); skill names no longer carry the quotes from their frontmatter (#173); Hermes skills are found at any depth and toggled via `skills.disabled`, the way `hermes skills` does it (#172); Kit installs of OpenCode MCP servers honor `opencode.jsonc` (#167, #168).
